comment: Every Board change's result, for both the app's reducer (ui/src/board/apply.ts, run by apply.test.ts) and the server (api/internal/boardchange, run by table_test.go), so they can't drift. Each case applies change to before (the board below when absent) and gives the board after, or dropped when the server refuses it and the app drops it. Tasks are listed in their cards.

cases.name: createCard adds the card at the end
createCard of an id the board has is already saved
updateCard of the name keeps the description
updateCard of the description keeps the name
updateCard of a deleted card is dropped
updateCard that changes nothing is dropped
deleteCard deletes the card and its tasks
deleteCard of a deleted card changes nothing
moveCard goes right after the card before it
moveCard to the end
moveCard to the start
moveCard whose card before was deleted goes right before the card after it
moveCard whose neighbours were both deleted goes to the end
moveCard with no neighbours goes to the end
moveCard goes right after the card before it, even when a teammate moved another card in between
moveCard of a deleted card is dropped
createTask adds the task at the end of its card
createTask in a deleted card is dropped
createTask of an id the board has is already saved
createTask of an id a teammate has since moved to another card is already saved
updateTask of the status keeps the name and description
updateTask of the name and description keeps the status
updateTask finds a task a teammate moved to another card
updateTask of a deleted task is dropped
updateTask that changes nothing is dropped
deleteTask deletes the task
deleteTask finds a task a teammate moved to another card
deleteTask of a deleted task changes nothing
moveTask within its card
moveTask to another card
moveTask whose task before was deleted goes right before the task after it
moveTask whose neighbours were both deleted goes to the end of the card
moveTask whose neighbour was moved to another card goes to the end of the card
moveTask to an empty card
moveTask from a card other than the one a teammate moved it to
moveTask to a deleted card is dropped
moveTask of a deleted task is dropped
cleanUp deletes the tasks done on screen

cleanUp deletes the tasks it names, whatever their status now
cleanUp finds a task a teammate moved to another card
cleanUp of deleted tasks changes nothing
